code.extract_of: the clock only. It runs solar_tick.py with --offline and the clock pinned to the time the published run read (the generated field of data/solar_live.json), which the desk uses to tell a settled or passed row from an open one

name: SOLAR
sources: NOAA SWPC Report and Forecast of Solar and Geophysical Activity as first published, ftp://ftp.swpc.noaa.gov/pub/warehouse/ (data/raw/warehouse), with our own dated copies in data/snapshots.
NOAA SWPC Edited Solar Events and daily indices, ftp://ftp.swpc.noaa.gov/pub/indices/ (data/raw/indices and the event lists).
GFZ Potsdam Kp, https://kp.gfz.de/ (data/raw/gfz, the file Kp_ap_Ap_SN_F107_since_1932.txt).
why_not_included: the GFZ file the desk reads for Kp also carries sunspot numbers under CC BY-NC 4.0 and F10.7 from DRAO and NRCan, which the data pack leaves out
